description:
Telegram channel/group/bot/user card from t.me: name, type, verification, description, photo and subscriber/member/online counts.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: username (string), name (string), type (string), is_verified (boolean), description (string), photo_url (string, nullable), subscriber_count (integer, nullable), member_count (integer, nullable), online_count (integer, nullable), monthly_users (integer, nullable), extra_text (string, nullable), link (string), preview_url (string, nullable).

username.description: Telegram username, @handle or t.me link. Example: "durov"
